tools.name: search_birthplace
tools.description: Find disambiguated birthplace candidates and GeoNames ids for “where was I born”, “luogo di nascita”, “cerca città”. Ask the user to choose when more than one plausible match exists; never guess. No birth data is stored or logged, including request bodies, queries, access logs, stats and errors.

tools.name: calculate_birth_chart
tools.description: Calculate a complete natal chart for “my birth chart”, “tema natale”, “calcola tema natale”: planets, Ascendant, Whole Sign houses, major aspects, uncertainty and one-line meanings with links. Approximate times need a ±15,30,60 or 120 minute window; supports fold choice and historic offset override.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_retrograde_periods · Public sink: get_retrograde_periods.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_retrograde_periods · Public sink: get_retrograde_periods

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
